fieldNotes.location: Confirmed large cereal manufacturing complex (Cinnamon Toast Crunch) at 15200 Industrial Park Blvd NE, Covington GA. Geocode pin was ~2.5km of city-level offset corrected by satellite + web search; locked center 33.6228,-83.8240.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully perimeter-fenced (black ornamental metal fence visible in Street View along Industrial Park Blvd NE). Single private access road serves the campus from the SW corner near a road intersection. Treated as a controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identifiable at the property line; Street View coverage does not extend onto the private entrance road so a booth could exist but none seen. An interior structure near 33.6225,-83.8246 appears to be a covered break/smoking shelter, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the assumption of gate without confirmed staffed booth; low confidence - flagged.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has two large building clusters (west production block and east production/warehouse block) plus several smaller buildings.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Four distinct trailer drop yards counted: NW lot, N lot near water tower, and two SE lots by the main dock face - well over 50 trailer stalls combined.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Main dock face on the SE side shows ~30-40 trailers backed in across two banks; additional doors on the east building. Estimated 50+ total.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity spread across separate building faces (SE main dock bank and east-building dock bank) supports separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery; flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~146 acres but the property is heavily forested; usable paved industrial core is roughly 45-55 acres.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible entering the property; the diagonal cleared strips east of the plant are a power-line right-of-way, not rail.
